biography.description: Impeccably dressed human male with an easy smile and magnetic presence. His tailored suits and confident bearing mark him as someone used to being in charge of any room he enters.
biography.background: Born into a mid-level corporate family in Dallas, Dominic discovered his magical talents as a teenager when he realized people simply did what he asked. After a corporate extraction gone wrong exposed his SINner status, he went freelance as a face and negotiator in the Seattle shadows.

system.description: A sleek, stylish light pistol favored by corporate executives and their bodyguards. Perfect for concealed carry under a tailored suit.
Insulated gloves with built-in capacitors that deliver a powerful electric shock on contact.
system.gameEffect: Deals 8S(e) damage with AP -5. Useful for subduing targets non-lethally.

system.description: A luxurious armored long coat made from high-end ballistic fabrics. Looks like high fashion while providing serious protection.
The adept's voice carries an air of authority that compels compliance.
system.gameEffect: +2 dice to Leadership tests when issuing direct commands.

system.description: The adept maintains supernatural composure under pressure.
system.gameEffect: +1 per rating to Composure and Judge Intentions tests.

system.description: The adept has supernatural control over micro-expressions and body language.
system.gameEffect: +1 per rating to resist Social tests to read the adept. Also adds to social limit.

system.description: The adept has precise control over their vocal cords, enabling them to mimic voices and project their voice at unusual volumes.
system.gameEffect: Grants voice modulation, mimicry, and projection abilities.

system.description: The adept's magical nature enhances a specific skill beyond normal limits.
system.gameEffect: +2 to Con skill rating (can exceed natural maximum).

system.description: The adept's senses are magically enhanced.
system.gameEffect: +1 to Perception and Assensing tests per rating.

system.description: The adept has a supernatural gift for languages, able to quickly learn and understand unfamiliar tongues.
system.gameEffect: Allows the adept to learn languages at accelerated speed and attempt to comprehend unknown languages.

system.description: The adept can subtly alter their facial features through magical manipulation of bone and tissue.
system.gameEffect: +1 per rating to Disguise and Impersonation tests.

system.description: Glands implanted in the body that release tailored pheromones to subtly influence those nearby, enhancing social interactions.
system.gameEffect: +3 dice to Social skill tests. Also adds to Social Limit.

system.description: The character makes a strong first impression, gaining bonus dice on Social tests during initial meetings.
system.gameEffect: +2 dice pool modifier to social tests during a first meeting.

system.description: The character's appearance is utterly forgettable. People have difficulty remembering specific details about them.
system.gameEffect: +2 to limit for social tests to blend in. -2 to attempts to identify or remember the character.

system.description: The character has a corporate limited SIN, making them a registered citizen of a megacorporation. Subject to tracking and taxation.
The character harbors a deep prejudice against Aztechnology and its employees, stemming from the corporate extraction that ruined his family.
system.gameEffect: -2 dice on social tests involving Aztechnology personnel. May need to make Composure tests to remain civil.

system.description: A slim platinum bracelet engraved with subtle magical symbols, bonded to sustain the Kinesics adept power.
system.gameEffect: Sustains the Kinesics adept power, freeing power points.

system.description: A sophisticated electronic device for detecting surveillance equipment and hidden transmitters.
system.gameEffect: Provides dice pool for detecting bugs and surveillance devices.

system.description: Small, concealable communication device with skinlink capability.
High-end AR-enabled contact lenses with built-in vision enhancements.
Discreet earbuds with audio enhancement capabilities.
A luxury sedan that projects wealth and status. Silvertongue's preferred vehicle for meeting clients and attending high-society events.
The head host at an exclusive restaurant in Downtown Seattle. Always has a table for Silvertongue and can arrange private dining for discreet meetings.
A well-connected fixer who operates through a network of dead drops and encrypted messages. She specializes in high-end corporate jobs.
An executive secretary at a mid-tier subsidiary of Ares Macrotechnology. Provides insider corporate intel in exchange for nuyen.
An elderly talismonger who runs a small shop in Puyallup. He has been Silvertongue's mentor in understanding the magical side of his abilities.
Owner of The Velvet Room, a trendy nightclub in Tacoma. She hears everything that goes on in Seattle's social scene.
